newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta weekly reverse repo rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Malta weekly reverse repo rates unchanged.

text.p: The Malta Central Bank weekly reverse repo (absorption) rate was unchanged on Monday at 5.000 percent, only slightly higher from 4.980 percent on August 9.
The rate started the month at 4.979 percent.

The yield was also unchanged in one-month treasury bills at 4.996 percent. Six-month bills were at 5.290 percent and one-year bills at 5.360 percent. The yield on three-month treasury bills was slightly down at 4.997 from 4.998 on August 16.
The central Bank discount rate stood at 5.5 percent.
